## 7. Known Business Risk To Verify
```text
Some services share the same family dashboard.
Need to verify whether section_id is preserved after routing.
If section_id is preserved, each service can show specific content.
If section_id is lost, dashboard may mix content from other services.

Critical examples:
- Restaurants vs Laundry vs Food Grocery all delivery-service
- Fashion vs AKAP Ticket both ecommerce-service
- Rental Service vs Hotel / Homestay both rental-service
- Parcel Service vs Document vs Motor Delivery all parcel_delivery
- Home vs Technician vs ART vs Emergency all ondemand-service
```
